question: Which university faculty members' salaries are closest to the average salary for their respective ranks? Please provide the ranks, first names, last names, and salaries.university
sql:
WITH rank_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    FacRank,
    AVG(FacSalary) AS avg_salary
  FROM university_faculty
  GROUP BY FacRank
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    f.FacRank,
    f.FacFirstName,
    f.FacLastName,
    f.FacSalary,
    ABS(f.FacSalary - ra.avg_salary) AS diff_from_avg
  FROM university_faculty f
  JOIN rank_avg ra ON f.FacRank = ra.FacRank
),
min_diff AS (
  SELECT FacRank, MIN(diff_from_avg) AS min_diff
  FROM with_diff
  GROUP BY FacRank
)
SELECT 
  wd.FacRank,
  wd.FacFirstName,
  wd.FacLastName,
  wd.FacSalary
FROM with_diff wd
JOIN min_diff md ON wd.FacRank = md.FacRank AND wd.diff_from_avg = md.min_diff
ORDER BY wd.FacRank, wd.FacFirstName
